teaser: Running an AI build event where everyone ships something someone else can use: guidance on the primitives, from browser-only to synthetic users.
core_idea: The best AI onboarding is a bring-your-own-problem build day, and its hardest goal is getting each person to ship something someone else can use; that takes primitives in place before the day: AI and agents running the event itself, a browser-only workspace with nothing to install and no payments, prepared cases and recipes, villagers and synthetic users in the room, a client-side architecture on GitHub Pages, five stages people can climb, and synthetic users testing the event beforehand, all so people feel the feedback loop.

quotes.text: The most challenging part of these days is not getting somebody to build something.
Otherwise you are talking about advanced technology without using it yourself.
Nobody should face a blank page.
